decision_clarity-2: PLAN.md:72 (D-3 exclusion reasons) — When one file meets more than one of `missing`, `outside_project`, and `pattern_mismatch` (e.g. a missing `gone.md` that also fails the glob, or an outside path that does not exist), it is unclear which reason is recorded. Specify the check order (e.g. outside_project → missing → pattern_mismatch) or a single-reason priority rule.

advisories.basis: Both rows run the same resolve command on the same setup. In the S-6 infer variant (TEST-SCENARIO.md:28, 'pyproject.toml만 있는 변형' + resolve with the infer source), the setup and command are identical to S-8 (b) (TEST-SCENARIO.md:30, 'pyproject.toml만 있는 프로젝트' + `resolve --project-root <tmp>`). The only difference is what each row asserts: S-6 checks `source_path` and S-8 (b) checks the `run`/`run_files` values. Running one execution against two separate expectation rows duplicates the verification signal.
